children: none, because it is a leaf: one seam (the point where the tester spawns a proof subprocess), one owner, one proof. The one thing that could have been a child — cleaning the 440 fixture records already standing in the live tree — is deliberately NOT one: it is an act on a record of truth needing its own answer under Law 7 (append a retraction, drop the trails, or leave them and mark the era), and it does not gate this build, which changes only what happens next. It is named in missing_check as out of scope rather than left to be rediscovered.

watchme.trigger: each full corpus run — it rides the run the tester already performs, never a clock, and needs no live host and no inference: it compares bytes in ~/.cairn/logs before and after a run that has already happened.
watchme.enough: NOT satisfied by the corpus it was written against — a floor proved only by the proofs that already exist is a claim about nothing. Enough when the invariant has held across at least TWO proofs written AFTER this ticket lands, because the failure being watched for is a NEW proof reintroducing the default: the seam makes isolation the resting state, and the question the watch answers is whether a proof written next month inherits it without its author knowing it exists. Same enough-clause shape as the parent's, deliberately borrowed.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the two byte-counts it compares (live logs before, live logs after) and the count of proofs written since the ticket landed — measured values rather than a pass word, so a later reader sees whether the coverage claim moved or merely repeated.
watchme.nexus: the diagnostic nexus — what a mind needs on disk to diagnose a red without a second exploration. It teaches the same tree diagnostic_inspector's filters read, and its specific contribution is the honesty of that tree rather than its size.
watchme.consumer: CC at the moment of a red, through diagnostic_inspector — the surface that would otherwise present a fixture as evidence of something that happened; and Akien at session-open if the tree starts taking writes from proofs again.
